title: lecture.json
description: A lecture's manifest: everything about a lecture that is not the fragment.

id.description: the folder name; the server overwrites it with the one in the path

kind.description: `split` records which file it came from; a merged manifest has neither

number.description: the lecture number in the course

title.description: the lecture's title, as the h1 reads, in the course's language

slidesTitle.description: the <title> of the deck, when there is one

kicker.description: the standfirst spans the shell injects: course line, lecture line, reading

reading.description: the reading line, usually the last kicker span

published.description: written by the publish route; a client body carrying it is a 400

demo.description: a course demo: { kind: 'file', demo: '<slug>', aspect?, title? }

kind.description: always `file`; there is one kind of demo

aspect.description: height ÷ width, copied from the demo's demo.json when wired

title.description: the demo's title, copied when wired so a published page needs no API

demoMap.description: demo mounts, keyed by the selector of the empty div in the fragment
